df::df-6::T::incoming.causeDescription: Embedded bus carries no integrity protection or authentication — data is transmitted in plaintext
df::df-6::T::incoming.threatDescription: Data tampering on embedded bus DF-6 between Debugger and Alarm Processing Controller

df::df-6::T::outgoing.attackDescription: Attacker intercepts the response from Alarm Processing Controller and modifies data, causing Debugger to process falsified information
df::df-6::T::outgoing.causeDescription: Missing integrity protection on the response flow from Alarm Processing Controller — Debugger cannot detect modified responses
df::df-6::T::outgoing.threatDescription: Response tampering: Attacker modifies response data before it reaches Debugger
